title: Some Nostalgia I had.
author: on_line187
selftext:
https://apps.apple.com/es/app/ar-hunter/id6804480867?l=en-GB

I was thinking why do we not have duck hunt in AR? 

I chatted about it a bit and in about an hour and a half it was done. Not quite 1 shot since I wanted to adjust a few things but it was playable on the first try too. I added a few small things like a scanner and timer just to make it a bit more smooth to play. 

The ducks are set to appear around 3.5-5 meters from you using lidar and they can hide behind things in the real world. 

A fun project over the weekend. Feel free to give it a try
